name: chat-message
title: Chat message
description: One message: the person's words exactly as typed, on the right, with the chips they sent and a chip per file they attached; the agent's words through the host's renderer, on the left, outlined while said partway through a turn.

files.template: message-template.ts (messageTemplate, chipTemplate, chipParts, fileChipTemplate, fileIcon, REMOVE_ICON)

attributes.data-interim: the agent's words partway through a turn

methods.show(entry, render): draws one person or agent entry from the feed's core

whenNotToUse: System lines and change chips (the feed's own rows).
accessibility: A hidden 'You:' or 'Agent:' leads the words. Chips and files are a list named 'Sent with it'; a file's chip is its name, never a link (the board serves no attached file), with its direction from the name (dir=auto).
